versions.summary: Add selectable stable/Ink Box compatibility flashing profiles; stable mode keeps the PaperS3 0xFlash reset sequence, while compatibility mode uses Ink Box-style esptool parameters for verification.
Force ESP32-S3 USB reset mode and idle DTR/RTS control lines to improve ROM sync on Android USB Serial/JTAG.
Fix Android USB serial tiny reads by staging data through a larger native read buffer.
Return full native/Python esptool bridge errors to the app instead of losing the root cause behind Java stack traces.
Fix Chaquopy bridge conversion for Kotlin ArrayList esptool arguments.
Fix Chaquopy Java class loading for Android USB serial bridge.
Refactored flashing backend to Android Chaquopy/Python with official esptool.py for better stability.
Last Dart handwritten ESP32 flashing backend release; superseded by v0.3.0.
